paper.title_en: Diagonally gauged anomaly-free 6D supergravities and their vacua
paper.abstract_en: We study anomaly-free six-dimensional $N=(1,0)$ supergravities with $n_T=1$ and diagonal $U(1)_{R+}$ or $Sp(1)_{R+}$ gauging. The diagonal group combines R-symmetry with a commuting action on hypermultiplets. We perform bounded searches for anomaly-free models with one or two additional simple gauge group factors of rank at most 30, impose string-charge lattice and positive kinetic term conditions, and tabulate the resulting spectra. The main scans cover $q_{\max}\leq2$ and $d_{\max}\leq3$, where $q_{\max}$ is the largest absolute hyperino charge and $d_{\max}$ the largest diagonal $Sp(1)$ representation dimension, with supplementary searches at larger values. Every hypermultiplet block is required to be nontrivial under at least one additional simple gauge factor. The search has led to a large number of models. Here we give the details of 93 models with $G_+= U(1)_{R+}$ and $q_{\rm max}\le 2$, and 26 models with $G_+=Sp(1)_{R+}$ and $d_{\rm max}\le 3$, and one or two simple group factors. Additional 1341 and 494 models with $G_+=U(1)_{R+}$ with $q_{\rm max}=2$ and $Sp(1)_{R+}$ with $d_{\rm max}=3$, respectively, are posted to the GitHub repository. We establish the existence of supersymmetric Minkowski vacua for all the anomaly free models we have found with $q_{\rm max}=2$ and $d_{\rm max}=3$. We find that such vacua require $q_{\max}>1$ for $U(1)_{R+}$, and $d_{\max}>2$ for $Sp(1)_{R+}$. We also show that every Minkowski vacuum breaks R-symmetry, with the connected unbroken gauge group contained in the additional gauge factors. At two-derivative order, while our anomaly free models do not admit AdS$_6$ solutions, all those with $q_{\rm max} = 2$ and $d_{\rm max}=3$ have non-supersymmetric and unstable dS$_6$ vacua as well.
